packageRules.description: Routine compatible updates move together; majors remain separate.
A new Go language version moves separately from library updates.
Go patch releases can fix standard-library vulnerabilities and do not wait for the weekly window.
codeql-action init, analyze and upload-sarif must move together.

Renovate's mise manager runs `mise lock` on every dependency a branch moves in mise.toml, this file's regex dependencies included, and mise refuses to lock min_version's jdx/mise, which is no tool; no Renovate option keeps another manager's dependency out of that command, so min_version moves on a branch where no mise tool does.

description: Routine updates arrive together weekly; majors separately, security fixes immediately. No automatic merges.

customManagers.description: mise itself is pinned by min_version; the mise manager reads the tools.
